description: Color-distance blend across N biomes. For each biome's reference color, compute distance to the probe + soft-min weight = max(0, softness - distance)^2. Returns the unnormalized weights AND the sum (the consumer typically uses weight/wsum for the blend). Per-biome reference colors are embedded as compile-time constants from the biomes list.

wsum.doc: sum of all per-biome weights. The per-biome weights themselves are emitted as side-effect locals named w_<biome.name>, consumed implicitly by paired primitives (tile_sample_per_biome, weighted_material_blend) that follow in the same stage.

constants._doc: Per-biome reference colors are emitted as const vec3 BIOME_COLOR_<NAME> = vec3(...) — compiler walks inputs.biomes and emits one const per biome.
